blocks.heading: Bigger barns, or heavenly treasure?
blocks.body:
Many Christians feel a tension. You have a heart for generosity and a desire to make a Kingdom impact, but career, family and the complexity of 401(k)s, taxes and college savings keep pushing it to someday.

We help you answer the big questions. When is enough truly enough? And how can you use your wealth to build heavenly treasure instead of just bigger barns? (Luke 12:16-21)
bullets: No more wondering what to do with old 401(k)s from past jobs
Advisors who help you navigate taxes and investments as a high earner
Biblical insight to put your resources to work for your family and the Kingdom

blocks.heading: Who we serve
blocks.body: Most of our clients come to us at one of these moments.

items.title: Busy professionals
items.body: Physicians, attorneys and executives with old 401(k)s, heavy taxes and no time to sort it out.

items.title: Business owners
items.body: Planning a sale or a transition, and asking what the proceeds should do next.

items.title: Nearing retirement
items.body: A few years out and ready to move from building wealth to building a legacy.

items.title: Facing a loss
items.body: When the person you leaned on for money decisions is gone, we keep things simple and clear.

blocks.heading: How it works
blocks.body: A transparent, relational process designed to build trust at every step.
items: Discovery call: 15 minutes, no pressure. Tell us your story, your goals and your biggest questions. No statements needed.
Deep dive: 1 to 2 hours. We gather the details, ask about your values, hopes and dreams, and analyze the full picture.
Strategy and implementation: a clear, customized plan, then help putting it into action alongside your other professionals.
Ongoing guidance: check-ins as often as you need, adjustments as life happens, and encouragement to live into all God has for you.

blocks.heading: What we do
blocks.body: A holistic, values-driven approach. Our service is fiduciary and fee-based.

items.title: Wealth plan
items.body: Evaluate where you are today and build a plan to reach your goals and dreams.

items.title: Portfolio management

items.title: Estate planning

items.title: Life goals blueprinting

items.title: Risk management

items.title: Business transitions

blocks.heading: Meet your advisors
blocks.body: Your advisor should be more than a number-cruncher. They should be a wise counselor who shares your values.
